"Electric 10s" is down to five top prizes after a $30,000 winner was claimed four days ago. The game started with six top prizes. Know that before you buy, because a change in top prizes changes the whole game.

Everything above about "Electric 10s" comes from the Texas Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
2772.headline: Fewer $30,000 prizes left

2773.body:
The most common win left on "Sugar Skull Cash" is $5. The second biggest prize left is $1,000, and 49 of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

Everything above about "Sugar Skull Cash" comes from the Texas Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
2773.headline: A close look at the prizes

2774.body:
"The Price is Right™" is new from the Texas Lottery. It is a $10 game with four top prizes of $250,000. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

Every line of The Price is Right™'s prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
